reasons: Directionally correct: HDI is the vendor (designs, develops, hosts the Site) and the Company/Deerskin is our client, so inserting a one-way warranty running from HDI to the Company protects our side.

The 'missing' status is supported by the cited text: Section 9(a) is limited to mutual corporate existence/authority/enforceability representations and 9(b) is a Globix carve-out, with no performance, conformance, compliance-with-law or malicious-code warranty and no remedy; the rationale also correctly notes no disclaimer exists to carve out from.

The inserted new Section 9(c) tracks the preferred position and model language closely (workmanlike services, 12-month conformance of Site/software to specs and documentation, legal compliance, no malicious code, plus re-performance/repair-or-replacement/refund remedy) and is an addition only — no existing language is disturbed, so the edit is minimal.
Comment is accurate, correctly prefixed, concise, first-person plural, cites the playbook position and offers the 90-day/30-day fallback.
